scripts.dev: npm run build:sim && npm run dev --workspace @doofy-duck/web -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.test:parity: npm run build:sim && vitest run packages/game-sim/test/fixtures.test.ts && go -C services/core/simulation test -count=1 -run Foundation2 ./...
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:go && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sim && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:sim && npm run build:web
